arxiv-2103-10971.title: Evidence for a Cosmic Ray Gradient in the IM Lup Protoplanetary Disk
arxiv-2103-10971.creator: Richard A. Seifert, L. Ilsedore Cleeves, Fred C. Adams, Zhi-Yun Li
arxiv-2103-10971.description: Abstract Protoplanetary disk evolution is strongly impacted by ionization from the central star and local environment, which collectively have been shown to drive chemical complexity and are expected to impact the transport of disk material. Nonetheless, ionization remains a poorly constrained input to many detailed modeling efforts.

arxiv-2207-05310.title: Second order hydrodynamics based on effective kinetic theory and electromagnetic signals from QGP
arxiv-2207-05310.creator: Lakshmi J. Naik, V. Sreekanth
arxiv-2207-05310.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Lakshmi J. Naik, V. Sreekanth. We study the thermal dilepton and photon production from relativistic heavy ion collisions in presence of viscosities by employing the recently developed second order dissipative hydrodynamic formulation estimated within a quasiparticle description of thermal QCD (Quantum Chromo-Dynamics) medium. The sensitivity of shear and bulk viscous pressures to the temperature dependence of relaxation time is analyzed within one dimensional boost invariant expansion of quark gluon plasma (QGP).

arxiv-2302-13407.title: DFSNet: A Steerable Neural Beamformer Invariant to Microphone Array Configuration for Real-Time, Low-Latency Speech Enhancement
arxiv-2302-13407.description: Abstract Invariance to microphone array configuration is a rare attribute in neural beamformers. Filter-and-sum (FS) methods in this class define the target signal with respect to a reference channel. However, this not only complicates formulation in reverberant conditions but also the network, which must have a mechanism to infer what the reference channel is.

arxiv-2312-12920.title: Fermi arcs, Landau levels and magnetic response of the nematic Weyl liquid
arxiv-2312-12920.creator: Carlos Naya, Tomaso Bertolini, Johan Carlström
arxiv-2312-12920.description: Abstract In classes of Weyl semimetals where the symmetry protects nodes with higher than unit charge, the nematic Weyl liquid appears as interactions destroy this underlying symmetry. In the symmetry-broken phase, the multiple-charge nodes are split into objects of unit charge, the position of which in momentum space is determined by the nematic order parameter.

arxiv-2312-13952.title: Cold and dense perturbative QCD in a very strong magnetic background
arxiv-2312-13952.creator: Eduardo S. Fraga, Letícia F. Palhares, Tulio E. Restrepo
arxiv-2312-13952.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Eduardo S. Fraga, Letícia F. Palhares, Tulio E. Restrepo. We compute the pressure from first principles within perturbative QCD at finite baryon density and very high magnetic fields up to two-loops and with physical quark masses.

arxiv-2401-00788.title: Astraios : Parameter-Efficient Instruction Tuning Code Large Language Models
arxiv-2401-00788.creator: Terry Yue Zhuo, Armel Zebaze, Nitchakarn Suppattarachai, Leandro von Werra Harm de Vries Qian Liu Niklas Muennighoff
arxiv-2401-00788.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Terry Yue Zhuo, Armel Zebaze, Nitchakarn Suppattarachai, Leandro von Werra Harm de Vries Qian Liu Niklas Muennighoff. The high cost of full-parameter fine-tuning (FFT) of Large Language Models (LLMs) has led to a series of parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods. However, it remains unclear which methods provide the best cost-performance trade-off at different model scales. We introduce Astraios , a suite of 28 instruction-tuned OctoCoder models using 7 tuning methods and 4 model sizes up to 16 billion parameters.

arxiv-2403-11920.title: Bangladesh Agricultural Knowledge Graph: Enabling Semantic Integration and Data-driven Analysis–Full Version
arxiv-2403-11920.creator: Rudra Pratap Deb Nath, Tithi Rani Das, Tonmoy Chandro Das, S. M. Shafkat Raihan
arxiv-2403-11920.description: Abstract In Bangladesh, agriculture is a crucial driver for addressing Sustainable Development Goal 1 (No Poverty) and 2 (Zero Hunger), playing a fundamental role in the economy and people’s livelihoods. To enhance the sustainability and resilience of the agriculture industry through data-driven insights, the Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics and other organizations consistently collect and publish agricultural data on the Web.

arxiv-2405-08234.creator: Li Li
arxiv-2405-08234.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Li Li. Berenstein and Zelevinsky introduced quantum cluster algebras [ 2 ] and the triangular bases [ 3 ] . The support conjecture proposed in [ 8 ] , which asserts that the support of each triangular basis element for a rank-2 cluster algebra is bounded by an explicitly described region, was established in [ 9 ] for skew-symmetric rank-2 cluster algebras.

arxiv-2409-08317.title: Cosmology of light towers and swampland constraints
arxiv-2409-08317.creator: Gonzalo F. Casas 1, Ignacio Ruiz 1, 2
arxiv-2409-08317.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Gonzalo F. Casas 1, Ignacio Ruiz 1, 2. We study the dynamical evolution of FLRW cosmologies in the presence of a tower of scalar light states and a runaway exponential potential. Some of the attractor solutions have problematic behaviours from the EFT point of view, which we use to argue for restrictions on the possible exponential scalings of the potential and tower characteristic mass as we move towards asymptotic regions in moduli space.

arxiv-2502-15670.title: Formation mechanism, stability and role of zinc and sulfur vacancies on the electronic properties and optical response of ZnS
arxiv-2502-15670.creator: P.R.A de Oliveira, L.Lima, G.Felix, P.Venezuela, Fernando Stavale
arxiv-2502-15670.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by P.R.A de Oliveira, L.Lima, G.Felix, P.Venezuela, Fernando Stavale. Combining experimental and theoretical tools, we report that Zn vacancies play an important role in the electronic and optical responses of ZnS sphalerite. The defective surface of ZnS (001) single crystal prepared in ultra-high vacuum conditions, has been shown to exhibit a semiconducting character instead of the insulating properties of the pristine structure, as revealed by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS).

arxiv-2511-03394.title: The subtle statistics of the distance ladder: On the distance prior and selection effects 2026 The subtle statistics of the distance ladder: On the distance prior and selection effects – A.2
arxiv-2511-03394.creator: Harry Desmond, Richard Stiskalek, José Antonio Nájera, Indranil Banik
arxiv-2511-03394.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Harry Desmond, Richard Stiskalek, José Antonio Nájera, Indranil Banik. Statistical methodology is rarely considered significant in distance ladder studies or a potential contributor to the Hubble tension. We suggest it should be, highlighting two appreciable issues. First, astronomical distances are inferred latent parameters, requiring a prior. We show that the common assumption of (perhaps implicit) uniform priors on distance moduli biases distances low due to objects being intrinsically uniformly distributed in volume. At fixed measured redshifts, this biases the Hubble constant high.

pmc-11359053.creator: Poyi Liu, Yunkang Zhang, Guanlun Guo, Jiale Ding
pmc-11359053.description: In infrared detection scenarios, detecting and recognizing low-contrast and small-sized targets has always been a challenge in the field of computer vision, particularly in complex road traffic environments. pmc-12572257.title: Exploring novel soliton, wave solutions, and modulation instability analysis for the (3+1)-dimensional KP-SKR equation using the improved generalized Riccati equation mapping approach
pmc-12572257.creator: Noha M Kamel, Hamdy M Ahmed, Wafaa B Rabie
pmc-12572257.description: In this work, new soliton and wave solutions for the (3+1)-dimensional Kadomtsev-Petviashvili-Sawada-Kotera-Ramani equation (KP-SKRE) were derived using the improved generalized Riccati equation mapping method (IGREMM). The KP-SKRE plays an essential role in modeling the phenomena of wave nonlinearity. The wave nonlinearity appears in fluid dynamics, plasma physics, and other fields that involve interactions between dispersion and nonlinearity.

pmc-12673413.creator: Benjamin Boudreau, Nicholas C Watson
pmc-12673413.description: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) are a novel class of drugs that have recently gained popularity for their ability to effectively manage type 2 diabetes mellitus and promote weight loss by delaying gastric emptying. The American Society of Anesthesiologists published consensus-based guidance in 2023 for the preoperative management of patients taking GLP-1 RAs.

pmc-12734734.title: Validation of the Controlling Nutritional Status (CONUT) Score and the Systemic Immune-Inflammation Index (SII) for Predicting Leakage and Surgical Complications After Head and Neck Free Flap Reconstruction: A Pilot Study
pmc-12734734.creator: Jun Won Lee
pmc-12734734.description: Background and Objectives: While many factors are known to influence adverse outcomes after head and neck cancer ablation with free flap reconstruction, two low-cost inflammatory–nutritional indices—the Controlling Nutritional Status (CONUT) score and the Systemic Immune-Inflammation Index (SII)—are not widely used. This pilot study evaluated their accuracy for predicting surgical complications, including flap-site leakage, and explored data-driven cutoff values.

pmc-13305674.title: sST2在心力衰竭患者中的临床应用价值
pmc-13305674.creator: 思瑶 黎, 浩能 唐, 若虹 陈, 晓联 章
pmc-13305674.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). 目的对心力衰竭进行准确的诊断和预后评估对于改善患者生活质量至关重要。本研究旨在探讨血清可溶性生长刺激表达基因2(soluble growth stimulation expressed gene 2，sST2)水平在是否合并肥胖/超重的心力衰竭患者中的临床应用价值。方法收集2023年10月至2024年3月中南大学湘雅二医院收治的心力衰竭患者的血清样本。将研究对象分为心力衰竭合并肥胖/超重组(n=71)、心力衰竭不合并肥胖/超重组(n=62)和健康对照组(n=60)。采用免疫荧光干式定量法测定血清sST2水平，分析不同组的sST2水平差异，评估sST2及相关代谢指标在不同心力衰竭患者中的临床应用价值。结果心力衰竭患者sST2、N末端脑钠肽前体(N-terminal pro-brain natriuretic peptide，NT-proBNP)、心肌肌钙蛋白T(cardiac troponin T，cTnT)和空腹血糖的血清水平均显著高于健康对照组，总胆固醇(total cholesterol，TC)、高密度脂蛋白胆固醇(high-density lipoprotein cholesterol，HDL-C)和低密度脂蛋白胆固醇(low-density lipoprotein cholesterol，LDL-C)的血清水平低于健康对照组(均P<0.05)。sST2水平与NT-proBNP、cTnT、血糖和三尖瓣反流流速(tricuspid regurgitation velocity，TRV)均呈显著正相关，与HDL-C和左室射血分数(left ventricular ejection fraction，LVEF)均呈显著负相关(均P<0.05)。sST2用于诊断心力衰竭在不合并肥胖/超重患者中的价值显著高于在合并肥胖/超重患者中的价值[曲线下面积(area under the curve，AUC)：0.803 vs 0.696]；sST2针对射血分数降低型心力衰竭(heart failure with reduced ejection fraction，HFrEF；LVEF≤40%)人群(AUC=0.807)和不合并超重/肥胖的HFrEF人群(AUC=0.802)具有较高的诊断价值(均P<0.001)；联合应用sST2、体重指数(body mass index，BMI)、HDL-C及年龄能显著提高对心力衰竭发病的诊断价值(AUC=0.983)。结论sST2对于非肥胖心力衰竭患者具有较高诊断价值，但在肥胖患者中价值有限。sST2与年龄、BMI和HDL-C联合检测能显著提高其对心力衰竭的诊断价值，该模型适用于基层医疗场景的快速心力衰竭筛查，但需前瞻性研究验证。 导 读 心血管疾病是我国高发、高致死的重大慢性疾病，涵盖冠心病、心力衰竭、心律失常等多种类型，代谢紊乱、衰老、免疫异常、药物毒性、肠道菌群失调等多重因素共同推动疾病的发生和发展，临床在机制解析、风险筛查、精准诊疗、预后评估等方面仍面临诸多挑战。《中南大学学报(医学版)》本期推出《心血管系统疾病预防和治疗专题》，汇集6篇原创研究与综述，围绕代谢调控、风险评估、生物标志物、药物安全、肠道代谢等方向展开探索，串联基础机制与临床应用，为心血管疾病的早防、早诊、精准干预提供新思路与实践参考。 生物标志物是心力衰竭精准诊断的重要抓手。相关研究探讨了可溶性生长刺激表达基因2蛋白(soluble growth stimulation expressed gene 2，sST2)在不同体重指数心力衰竭人群中的诊断效能，证实肥胖会干扰sST2检测结果，而sST2联合年龄、体重指数及高密度脂蛋白胆固醇可显著提高筛查准确度，尤其适用于基层快速诊断，为心力衰竭分型评估与预后判断提供了有效补充。在代谢指标预测方面，队列研究证实甘油三酯葡萄糖指数-腰围身高比是中老年人新发心血管疾病(尤其是心肌梗死)的独立危险因素，该指标存在非线性阈值效应，凭借简便易获取的优势，可作为普通人群心血管病早期筛查与风险预警的实用工具。在药物安全领域，基于FAERS数据库的分析系统评估了8种免疫检查点抑制剂的心血管不良事件特征，明确心肌炎、心包炎、心律失常及血管炎为高发严重不良反应，梳理用药人群、发病时间与死亡风险，强调用药前筛查、用药期间密切监测及多学科协作的重要性。在冠状动脉病变机制方面，研究阐明了糖酵解、脂肪酸氧化及线粒体代谢对内皮细胞可塑性与血管再生的关键作用，同时揭示衰老与免疫代谢紊乱如何削弱侧支形成能力，提出靶向代谢的干预策略，为缺血性心脏病的血管保护与修复提供理论依据。在急诊风险分层方面，围绕HEART评分系统的研究系统梳理了其在急性冠脉综合征中的应用价值，比较HEART、全球急性冠状动脉事件注册研究(global registry of acute coronary events，GRACE)、心肌梗死溶栓治疗(thrombolysis in myocardial infarction，TIMI)三类评分的适用场景，总结CARE、HEARTS3等改良方案，剖析该评分在主观判读、特殊人群及本土化应用中的局限，为国内急诊胸痛患者的快速分诊、危险分层与个体化治疗提供实操依据。此外，对于肠源性氧化三甲胺的相关综述，解析了其通过炎症、氧化应激及线粒体损伤等通路介导心脏骤停后多器官损伤的分子机制，揭示肠道菌群代谢与心血管危重症的关联，为心脏骤停后综合征开辟了靶向肠道代谢的全新干预方向。本专题立足临床痛点，兼顾基础机制探索与临床转化应用，覆盖慢病筛查、急症管理、药物警戒、危重症救治等多个维度，研究成果兼具理论深度与临床实用性。期待本专题推动心血管领域基础研究与临床实践的深度融合，助力我国心血管疾病规范化、精准化防治体系不断完善。 (大连大学基础医学院 陈颖卿教授) 心力衰竭(以下简称“心衰”)作为多种心脏疾病的严重表现或晚期阶段，其患病率在全球范围内呈上升趋势，成为重要的公共卫生问题[1]。尽管慢性心衰的治疗已取得一定进展，但目前的治疗措施仍主要集中在延缓病情进展而非逆转疾病本身[2]。因此，对心衰进行准确的诊断和预后评估对于改进患者疾病管理流程至关重要[3]。生物标志物在这一过程中扮演了关键角色，其中利钠肽长期以来被视为评估心衰的金标准。然而，利钠肽易受到机体多种因素的影响，限制了其广泛使用。 近年来，血清可溶性生长刺激表达基因2(soluble growth stimulation expressed gene 2，sST2)作为一种新兴的心衰生物标志物受到了广泛关注[4-5]。sST2不仅能反映心肌纤维化和心室重塑的程度，还在指导心衰治疗及预后评估中展现出较高的应用价值[6]。与传统生物标志物相比，sST2不受年龄、体重指数(body mass index，BMI)、血压、肾功能及心衰病因等因素的影响，能够提供精准的诊断和预后信息[7-8]。 尽管国内外已有针对sST2在心衰诊断和预后中的研究，但对于肥胖/超重这一特殊心衰人群的研究相对较少[9]。肥胖是心衰的重要风险因素之一，其通过影响心脏结构和功能，可能干扰传统生物标志物的表现形式和诊断能力[10-12]。深入探讨sST2在肥胖/超重心衰患者中的作用，不仅有助于填补现有研究空白，而且对于制订个性化的治疗策略具有重要意义。本研究旨在探索sST2作为心衰生物标志物在是否合并肥胖/超重的心衰人群中的临床应用价值，并进一步明确sST2与其他常用标志物联用对心衰诊断效能的影响。 pmc-13526886.title: Energy-controlled supercapacitors based on polybenzidine-oxidant-GO hybrid electrodes with vanadate and dichromate redox chemistry
pmc-13526886.creator: Aisan Moshgabadi, Reza Dadashi, Khalil Farhadi, Morteza Bahram
pmc-13526886.description: In this study, polybenzidine (PB) was successfully synthesized in situ on anodized graphite substrates (AGS) using dichromate (PB-C/AGS) and vanadate (PB-V/AGS) oxidants, and their electrochemical performance was systematically evaluated for supercapacitor applications. Structural analyses by ATR-IR, Raman, FE-SEM, EDX, and XRD confirmed the successful polymerization and incorporation of metal oxide species.

pmc-13688762.title: Health-related quality of life in childhood arthritis: the impact of generic versus disease-specific instruments
pmc-13688762.creator: Jelleke B. de Jonge, Sytze de Roock, Nele Grundhoefer, Deborah A. Marshall, Sebastiaan J. Vastert, Rae S. M. Yeung, Susanne M. Benseler, Joost F. Swart
pmc-13688762.description: BackgroundHealth-related quality of life (HRQoL) data provided by children with arthritis and their parents is critically important to enable co-design of care and shared decision making. However, there is significant heterogeneity in how HRQoL is captured, as both generic (EQ-5D-Y-5L) and disease-specific instruments (JAMAR) are available.
